news.title: TVS Motor Company leases five lakh sq ft office in Bengaluru for 10 years
news.para: TVS Motor Company has secured a long-term lease for over 500,000 sq ft of office space in Bengaluru. The lease will span more than ten years and aims to consolidate existing operations. This transaction reflects the growing trend among companies seeking larger office spaces. Bengaluru's office market continues to thrive, with demand extending beyond traditional business districts.

news.title: Spain aims to ban evictions until 2030 amid housing protests
news.para: The Spanish government on Tuesday approved measures including a ban on evictions until 2030 and the automatic renewal of tenant contracts, a minister said, following days of nationwide housing protests. Health Minister Monica Garcia listed on social media a series of measures including the eviction ban and the automatic contract renewals, saying what had been achieved was "unimaginable a month ago".

news.title: Panchkula civic body issues final warning to 100 property tax defaulters
news.para: In a decisive move, the Panchkula municipal corporation has issued final notifications to 100 individuals with outstanding property taxes totaling approximately Rs 10 crore. These defaulters must attend a hearing on October 5 to sidestep property confiscation. The municipality is also pursuing tax recovery from governmental offices and will publish an updated defaulter roster post the August 31 payment deadline.

news.title: Jharkhand CM and RMZ discuss plan to set up IT park in Ranchi
news.para: In a bid to enhance technology investments, an innovative IT park is planned for Ranchi by 2029, following talks between Chief Minister Hemant Soren and Deepak Chhabria of RMZ Infrastructure. This ambitious project aims to create around 20,000 jobs initially, with aspirations of reaching 75,000 in three years. Potential sites include areas near IIM Ranchi and the upcoming assembly complex.

news.title: Black Opal Consultants raises ₹15.69 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO
news.para: Black Opal Consultants has allotted 7.96 lakh shares to seven anchor investors at ₹197 per share, raising ₹15.69 crore ahead of its IPO. The ₹55 crore issue opens on September 29 and will close on October 1, 2026.

news.title: Patna high court seeks replies on Bihar property tax rules
news.para: The Patna high court has requested responses from the state government and Patna Municipal Corporation regarding a writ petition. This petition challenges the constitutional validity of the Bihar Municipal Property Rules from 2013. These rules are alleged to impose arbitrary property tax on buildings in urban areas of Bihar. The court will hear the matter again on November 23 for further proceedings.

news.title: OCs issued but possession delayed as lifts & amenities not ready, say Jaypee Wish Town homebuyers
news.para: Residents of Wish Town are voicing serious concerns over the quality of construction and delays linked to Suraksha Group. They are pushing for a thorough investigation into whether the approved resolution plan for the stalled projects is being followed. Numerous buyers have pointed out the lack of essential services and infrastructure, making it difficult to occupy their flats.

news.title: HSVP orders probe after two residential plots sold cheaper than regular ones in Gurugram
news.para: Haryana Shehri Vikas Pradhikaran is investigating the auction results of two residential corner plots in Gurgaon. The two corner plots sold for approximately half the price of general-category plots auctioned weeks earlier. An inquiry was initiated after discrepancies prompted concerns about the e-auction portal's integrity. Additionally, there was a delay in the issuance of the letter of intent for one of the plots.

news.title: Washington State Investment Board backed fund exits ₹550 crore investment in Noida’s Dasnac group
news.para: Kautilya Finance has successfully exited its investment in New Delhi-based Dasnac, realizing cash proceeds of Rs 550 crore. The investment relationship initiated in 2017 involved multiple financial years through various investment routes. Dasnac had raised Rs 420 crore from Kautilya Finance, which has now been fully repaid. The capital supported Dasnac’s residential development projects in Noida, including significant developments.

news.title: Haryana RERA upholds fully-paid buyer’s right to transfer property in Gurugram
news.para: The Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has empowered property owners by clarifying that buyers who have fully settled payments cannot be obstructed in property transfers due to untimely conveyance. This pivotal case involved Sukhvir, who struggled with transferring his commercial shop. Consequently, the authority mandated the promoter to compensate Sukhvir with interest and damages, marking a crucial win for buyers facing similar challenges.

news.title: NGT gives Greater Noida authority 10 more days to list unauthorised constructions
news.para: The National Green Tribunal has issued a 10-day extension for the Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority to report on unauthorized construction projects. This follows over a year of GNIDA's failure to deliver crucial information. Allegations of illegal building practices abound, including violations of environmental rules and missing necessary consents. Moreover, the UP Pollution Control Board highlighted GNIDA's hesitance to disclose pertinent details.

news.title: Mumbai EOW probes Suraksha Realty promoter’s fraud allegations over Jaiprakash Infratech deal
news.para: Mumbai Police’s Economic Offences Wing is probing allegations by Suraksha Realty director Vijaykumar Mohanlal Parekh against fellow promoter Sudhir Walia over alleged cheating, forgery and criminal conspiracy in the acquisition of Jaiprakash Infratech. Parekh alleged his group’s consent was bypassed and his brother’s digital signature was used without authorisation.

news.title: Orient Cables IPO receives 8.32 times subscription on day 2
news.para: The initial public offering of Orient Cables (India) Ltd saw significant interest from investors, indicating positive market reception. Subscription levels for the IPO reached 8.32 times on the second day of bidding. Non-institutional investors led with a subscription rate of 17.37 times, while retail investors subscribed 9.16 times. The IPO's closure date is set for September 29, with a price band established between Rs 258 and 272 per share.

news.title: UK first-time buyer scheme lifts housebuilders, but success hinges on design
news.para: Britain is set to launch the "Your First Home" scheme aimed at first-time buyers. This program will require only a 2.5% deposit, and government loans of up to 20% will be available. Details about income thresholds and price caps will be revealed in the upcoming budget next month. Housebuilder shares have already started to rise amid speculation about increased demand for new homes.

news.title: CBI files fresh chargesheet against builder-promoters in homebuyer fraud case
news.para: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has lodged a fresh chargesheet against the leaders and executives of Acme Realties, focusing on a fraudulent scheme aimed at homebuyers tied to the Acme Boulevard project in Mumbai. Findings suggest that the suspects potentially deceived homebuyers with misleading promises while unjustly benefiting financially.

news.title: Arisinfra to acquire additional 16% stake in Buildmex-Infra for ₹60 crore
news.para: Arisinfra Solutions will acquire an additional 16% stake in Buildmex-Infra for ₹60 crore, increasing its holding in the construction materials subsidiary to 92%. Buildmex’s revenue rose to ₹179.03 crore in FY26 from ₹17.93 crore in FY24.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh eases land-use conversion norms to promote investments in real estate
news.para: Uttar Pradesh government has implemented amendments to streamline land-use conversion for plots up to 6,000 square metres. Local development authorities now hold the power to approve land-use changes, which simplifies the approval process. These changes are part of a broader effort to enhance ease of doing business and encourage urban development. Defined timelines have been established to expedite application processing and reduce delays.

news.title: UK housebuilders stocks rally on homebuyer loan revival
news.para: Shares of British housebuilders surged following the rollout of a new equity loan scheme aimed at assisting first-time buyers struggling with rising mortgage rates. This government initiative is set to rejuvenate home sales, with analysts predicting a notable impact on transactions. Furthermore, suppliers of building materials have benefited from increased stock performance, contributing to a positive outlook for the construction industry as a whole.

news.title: Arvind SmartSpaces to jointly develop 2.5 acres residential project in Bengaluru
news.para: Arvind SmartSpaces has added a 2.5-acre residential high-rise project on Sarjapur Road, Bengaluru, through a joint development agreement. The project has a saleable area of about 3.6 lakh sq ft and an estimated top-line potential of ₹470 crore.

news.title: Government to fast-track pending urban land ceiling cases: Telangana revenue minister
news.para: In a bid to tackle the backlog of Urban Land Ceiling applications from the former government, the Congress administration has rolled out a series of measures. Revenue Minister Ponguleti Srinivas Reddy has stressed the critical need for swift action to mitigate land-related challenges. Memos have been distributed to promote the assessment and regularization of valid applications.
